verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that Antigravity publishes a live llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a product summary) and serves its docs as raw markdown (getting-started.md returns HTTP 200). An agent can therefore be pointed directly at agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown-docs offering, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is across all docs (the probe content is truncated).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://antigravity.google/llms.txt # Google Antigravity
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://antigravity.google/docs/getting-started.md # Getting Started with Antigravity 2.0
